caption:
Student loans are still the shakiest part of household credit. 📚

The New York Fed says 10.9% of student loan balances are now 90+ days past due, up from 10.6% last quarter. Total student debt: $1.66 trillion.

A late payment can show up on a credit report, so knowing your servicer status matters.

Have you checked your student loan status on your credit report lately?
